verdict.rationale: WorkOS is an enterprise authentication and identity platform, not an agent or AI host that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product type. The MCP evidence covers a different role. WorkOS publishes its own remote MCP server for managing a workspace, and AuthKit can act as the OAuth authorization server that secures your MCP server. Neither shows WorkOS connecting to external MCP servers to use their tools, so neither makes this client-side axis applicable.
